C. & S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 3373.
14. 3. 32.

March 14, 32.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your telegram, dated March 10, which reads as follows:-
"Miss Alexandra Stoliaroff without valid Passport
"has requested permission remain in Colony states
"she resided in Shanghai at 1027 Avenue Foch with
"Semichoff brother-in-law please say if she is of
"good character or if anything detrimental is known
"regarding her.
Police Hongkong".

The following telegram, dated March 12, was
sent in reply:-
"Referring to your telegram of 10th, nothing known
"against Stoliaroff.
Legiron".

Enquiries regarding Miss Alexandra Stoliaroff
show that she is a Russian born in Petrograd on April 6,
1879. She arrived in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R. in 1927
and worked, casually, until February 1932 when she
proceeded to Canton. She holds Chinese Passport No. 774
issued by the Public Safety Bureau at Shanghai on
January 23, 1932, enabling her to proceed to Canton via
Hongkong. This document is valid for return to Shanghai.

1932年3月14日。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下3月10日电报，电文如下：-
“亚历山德拉·斯托利亚罗夫小姐无有效护照
“申请留在殖民地，称其
“在上海霞飞路1027号与其
“妹夫 Semichoff 同住，请告知其品行是否
“端正，或是否有关于她的不利记录。
香港警方”。

作为回复，于3月12日发出以下电报：-
“参照阁下10日电报，对
“斯托利亚罗夫无所知。
Legiron”。

关于亚历山德拉·斯托利亚罗夫小姐的调查
显示，她系俄罗斯人，1879年4月6日出生于彼得格勒。
她于1927年从苏联抵达上海，并断续工作，
直至1932年2月前往广州。她持有中国护照第774号，
由上海公安局于1932年1月23日签发，
使其能够经香港前往广州。该文件适用于返回上海。

I have the honour to be,

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. B. REGISTRY File No. D 3323. SECTION 2 Station. 14 3 32 Date March 12 1932）

Subject (in full) Telegram from Hongkong re.Miss Alexandra Stoliaroff.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the attached telegram of March
10,1932 from the Hongkong Police on the subject of Miss Ale-
xandra Stoliaroff,I have to report that she is a Russian who
was born in Petrograd on April 6,1899. She arrived in Shang-
hai from the U.S.S.R. in 1927 and resided in this city casual-
ly working for the most part until some time in February 1932
when she proceeded to Canton. She holds Chinese passport
No 774 issued by the Public Safety Bureau at Shanghai on Janu-
ary 23,1932 enabling her to proceed to Canton via Hongkong.
This document is valid for return to Shanghai.
B.Y.Semichoff,her brother-in-law, an advertis-
ment designer by profession, has been resident of Shanghai
since 1918.
They are registered at the Russian Emigrants'
Committee,No 6-A Hongkong Road and nothing detrimental is
known in this office regarding either of them.

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch
（签名）

主题（全称） 关于亚历山德拉·斯托利亚罗夫小姐的香港电报。

制作人 D.S. Prokofiev 转交人 （签名）

关于附件中1932年3月10日香港警方
关于亚历山德拉·斯托利亚罗夫小姐的电报，本人须报告如下：她系俄罗斯人，
1899年4月6日出生于彼得格勒。她于1927年从苏联抵达上
海，并在本市居住，大部分时间断续工作，直到1932年2月的某
段时间前往广州。她持有中国护照
第774号，由上海公安局于1932年1月23日签发，
使其能够经香港前往广州。
该文件适用于返回上海。
B.Y. Semichoff，她的妹夫，职
业为广告设计师，自1918年起即为上海居民。
他们在香港路6-A号的俄国侨民委员会注册，本处
对他们二人均无所知不利记录。

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

特别分部主管警官
（签名）
